summary: Grupo Aval Acciones y Valores S.A., a Colombian bank holding company, filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 14, 2026, reporting a routine interest payment on its Seventh Issuance of Notes, which were issued in Colombian pesos under its domestic market program. The payment was made in accordance with the terms of the offering memorandum. No changes to the note terms, no extraordinary corporate event, and no other material information were disclosed. This is a standard debt-service communication from a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
